origin.description: The default transformer. It parses the brace and evaluates it.
origin.details: This is what glue calls for each brace unless a transformer is supplied.
origin.example:
env <- list2env(list(age = 50), parent = baseenv())
cat(as.character(identity_transformer("age + 1", envir = env)), "\n", sep = "")

translation.description: The default transformer. It evaluates the brace as a Python expression.
translation.details: An exact key is returned as stored, which keeps a dotted name intact. Anything else is evaluated as Python. R-only calls such as as.Date are not available.
